#                            times a flight controller reported its attitude
#                            (20 Hz)
#   s t_us yaw n (dk r)*n    one revolution starting at t_us: its true yaw
#                            (microradians), then n returns as the beam slot
#                            step from the previous return (slot k fires
#                            k/500 of the period after t_us, at azimuth
#                            k·0.72 degrees counter-clockwise from +x) and
#                            the range in mm
